usage: music-tagger nd stats [-h] [-o OUT] [--force]

Export a complete statistics snapshot (ratings, play counts, stars) from
Navidrome as JSON. The previous snapshot is kept as <name>.previous.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  -o, --out OUT  Output snapshot file (default:
                 /mnt/synology/media/music/stats.json).
  --force        Replace the current snapshot even if it loses more than 10%
                 of its songs, rated songs, or starred songs.
